column3: “makes a special vow” renders “makes extraordinary (pala’) a vow,” and “to dedicate himself” renders “to live as a Nazirite (nazir).”
“his separation” renders “his nezer,” his Nazirite consecration (throughout the chapter).
“very suddenly” renders “in an instant, suddenly,” and “his dedicated head of hair” renders “the head of his nezer” (also in verse 18).
“because of the dead person” renders “on account of the soul (nefesh).”
“the law” renders “the torah (instruction)” (also in verse 21); “he shall bring the offering” renders “one shall bring him.”
“the ram’s shoulder” renders “the arm (zeroa’) … from the ram.”
“offered by waving” and “offered by lifting up” render “of the wave offering” and “of the contribution.”
“what else he can afford” renders “what his hand reaches.”
“invoke My name on” renders “put my name on.”
